evals.name: real-briefs
evals.expected_output: One flag per brief, each on a different check.
assertions: bulk-callout.txt: flags 'owner named' and no other check
routing-override-audit-log.txt: flags 'success measure' and no other check
requisition-approval-chains.txt: flags 'scope stays bounded' and no other check
